remarks: Welcome to The Hemsworth, a beautifully crafted Green Built Certified 2-storey home in Riverside! Designed with the Craftsman elevation, this home features 3 bedrooms, 2.5 baths, a main-floor flex room, and an upper bonus room. Enjoy luxury vinyl plank flooring, 8' doors on the main level, TV conduits, and an electric fireplace with half stone and a mantle. The chef-inspired kitchen boasts quartz countertops, extended cabinetry, 39 uppers with fluted glass inserts, a panelled hood fan, built-in microwave, upgraded backsplash, pot/pan drawers, MDF pantry shelving, and a matte black silgranite sink. Upstairs offers an expanded layout featuring a laundry room with a folding counter, extra bonus room window, stairwell picture window, iron railing, and secondary bath with dual sinks. The luxurious ensuite includes double sinks, added drawers, and an upgraded swing glass shower. Includes an extended garage with floor drain, basement stairwell with 9' ceilings, triple patio slider, & BBQ gas line. (id:67522)
